meta.name: event-store-design
meta.description: Design and implement event stores for event-sourced systems. Use when building event sourcing infrastructure, choosing event store technologies, or implementing event persistence patterns.

copy.tagline: 设计事件流存储方案，支撑系统状态回溯。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在搭建事件驱动系统并需要规划数据持久化。
copy.tagline_en: Design event store solutions for event-sourced systems.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building event-driven systems and need to design data persistence.

howto.what: Claude 会运用该技能教你设计事件存储：包括按聚合流组织事件、满足追加/排序/版本/幂等等要求、对比主流存储技术，并给出事件不可修改等最佳实践。
howto.when: 当你要求构建事件溯源基础设施、选择事件存储技术或实现事件持久化模式时，该技能会介入。

say.text: 帮我设计一个订单聚合的事件存储，用PostgreSQL。
say.note: Claude会给出按聚合流组织的表结构和要点。

say.text: 比较EventStoreDB和Kafka作为事件存储的差异。
say.note: Claude会从适用场景和限制角度做对比。

say.text: 给我事件存储的schema模板和注意事项。
say.note: Claude会提供实现模板并提醒常见错误。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you in designing an event store: organizing events by aggregate stream, meeting append/ordering/versioning/idempotency needs, comparing storage technologies, and following best practices like event immutability.
howto.when_en: Activated when you ask to build event-sourcing infrastructure, choose an event store technology, or implement event persistence patterns.

say_en.text: Design an event store for an Order aggregate using PostgreSQL.
Compare EventStoreDB and Kafka as event stores.
say_en.note: Claude contrasts their use cases and limits.

say_en.text: Give me a sample event store schema and key rules.
say_en.note: Claude returns a template and pitfalls.
